summary: Iteration 8 testing complete. FORM VISIBILITY BUG FIXED. Found and fixed two root causes: (1) Login.js was not updated with the fix - still had justify-center and min-h-screen, (2) CSS rule '.bg-grain > *:not(aside)' was overriding absolute positioning on gradient div, causing it to take up space and push content down. Both issues fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: ROOT CAUSE 1: Login.js was NOT updated with the fix. It still had 'justify-center' and 'min-h-screen' while Register.js was updated. Fixed by applying same changes to Login.js.

ROOT CAUSE 2: CSS rule '.bg-grain > *:not(aside)' in index.css was overriding the 'absolute' class on gradient divs, making them position:relative and taking up space in flex layout. Fixed by changing selector to '.bg-grain > *:not(aside):not(.absolute):not([class*="absolute"])'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Form visibility bug is now resolved. The fix involved two changes: (1) Updated Login.js to use min-h-[100dvh], pt-6 pb-8 sm:pt-10, removed justify-center, Logo size=44, mb-4 sm:mb-6. (2) Updated CSS selector in index.css to exclude elements with 'absolute' class from the position:relative rule.
